_meta.description: Forensic Red-Flag scan per holding. Follows the dashboard Red Flags prompt: 4 categories scored /10 where 10 = clean (no concerns) and 0-3 = serious/multiple red flags. Overall = weighted average (Accounting 30%, Governance 30%, Financial 20%, Business 20%). Grounded in reported financials (OCF vs profit, receivables, debt/EBITDA, FCF, dilution), curated governance/risk flags, and public filings. NOT investment advice.
_meta.score_meaning: Higher = cleaner / fewer red flags. Lower = more or more-severe red flags.

amber_flags: Acquirer Vindhya Telelinks downgraded to CARE A/A1 (RWD) on 1 Apr 2026: EPC execution delays, debtors Rs 2,192 Cr, TD/PBILDT above 3.5x
FY26 CFO Rs -21 Cr vs PAT Rs 17 Cr; debtor days 96
Unexplained Q1 FY27 margin spike (OPM 17% vs 4-9%) and Rs 40.7 Cr OCI gains in comprehensive income
Trade-for-trade (BE) series; stock +76% in one month with negligible institutional holding
High client concentration and OFC price volatility (CARE 1 Apr 2026)
BIRLACABLE.summary: One critical flag: the stock trades far above what the approved 10:115 swap into Vindhya Telelinks would deliver, and the acquirer's credit profile has weakened. Operating red flags are moderate (working-capital absorption, thin disclosure), but the corporate-action arithmetic dominates the risk picture.
BIRLACABLE.sources: screener.in BIRLACABLE and VINDHYATEL (2026-09-04); CARE rationale 1 Apr 2026; scanx.trade 21 Mar 2026; TradeBrains 3 Aug 2026; screener announcements 14 Aug and 26 Aug 2026.

accounting.reason: Cash conversion healthy: CFO exceeded PAT in each of FY24-FY26 (FY26 CFO Rs 202 Cr vs PAT Rs 139 Cr), operating cycle stable at 71 days (CARE) and debtor days 74; acceptances are disclosed within total debt. Other income of Rs 46 Cr is about a quarter of FY26 PBT. No qualification or restatement found.

governance.reason: Stable promoter holding, no pledge, regular calls and timely filings; promoter warrant issue at disclosed terms. No adverse finding.

financial.reason: Leverage is the named concern: borrowings Rs 1,162 Cr at Mar-2026 (Rs 812 Cr a year earlier), total debt incl. acceptances Rs 1,234 Cr and TD/PBILDT 3.93x at Mar-2025 versus CARE's 4x negative trigger; interest Rs 138 Cr against operating profit Rs 355 Cr in FY26 (EBIT interest cover about 2.3x); working-capital utilisation 80-85%. Mitigants: CARE A/Stable, cash Rs 132 Cr (Sep-2025), accruals Rs 210-230 Cr vs Rs 76 Cr repayments.

business.reason: Steel price pass-through lags, competitive low-margin segments, US tariff uncertainty for hydraulics and Ascent, and dependence on order conversion; offsets are eight-division diversification, blue-chip clients and a Rs 1,008 Cr PEB order book plus USD 100 million US backlog.

amber_flags: Borrowings up 43% to Rs 1,162 Cr in FY26; TD/PBILDT 3.93x (Mar-2025) near CARE's 4x negative trigger
EBIT interest cover about 2.3x; FY26 FCF Rs -126 Cr on debt-funded capex
Promoter holding only 39.67%; no dividend ever paid
Q1 FY27 revenue growth 2.9% with legacy steel and railways declining
US tariff exposure on hydraulics and PEB US
PENIND.summary: No critical flags. The main amber theme is leverage relative to thin engineering margins; accounting quality and governance look clean, and the CARE A/Stable reaffirmation (31 Mar 2026) plus promoter warrant infusion provide comfort.
PENIND.sources: screener.in PENIND consolidated (2026-09-04); CARE rationale 31 Mar 2026; Arthneeti Q1 FY27 call summary 25 Aug 2026.

governance.reason: Stable, slightly rising promoter holding, no pledge, transparent capital-return policy and regular disclosure. No adverse finding.

financial.reason: Negative net debt: cash and liquid investments Rs 210-220 Cr against about Rs 80 Cr of debt at Mar-2026; TD/OPBDITA ~0.6x, interest cover 23x (Dec-2025), TD/TNW 0.1x; ICRA AA-(Stable) with liquidity termed strong. Clean.

UNIPARTS.summary: No critical flags and a fortress balance sheet; the only material risks are commercial (concentration, US tariffs, cyclicality), captured in the business category. Accounting and governance are clean.
UNIPARTS.sources: screener.in UNIPARTS consolidated (2026-09-04); ICRA rationale 7 May 2026; Arthneeti Q1 FY27 summary 25 Aug 2026.

governance.reason: Prompt rumour clarification and regular disclosure, but the company neither confirmed nor denied the reported promoter exit; ESOP-driven dilution of ~1.3 pp since listing. No adverse finding.

RISHABH.summary: No critical flags. Amber items are the unconfirmed promoter-exit report, the loss-making die-casting unit and a long working-capital cycle. Balance sheet is net cash and accounting looks clean, so financial risk is low.

SUDEEPPHRM.summary: No critical flags. The main amber issue is cash conversion (CFO far below PAT with very long inventory and receivable cycles), followed by execution risk on two greenfields and a valuation that prices in flawless delivery. Governance and leverage look clean but the listed record is only nine months old.
SUDEEPPHRM.sources: screener.in SUDEEPPHRM consolidated (2026-09-04); InvestorStack call summary 5 Aug 2026; Cofacto 5 Aug 2026.
